exposure: preeclampsia without fetal intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR)
preeclampsia with fetal intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR)
cohort: 30 pregnant women with preeclampsia (19 with IUGR, 11 without) and 20 healthy pregnant women (controls)
finding: The study found that decidual vasculopathy in the placental bed is more characteristic of preeclampsia itself, while changes in placental villi are primarily associated with the presence of IUGR.
